_comment: X-ray writer DPO (fora_report.cxr.train_dpo): start = reference = the SFT checkpoint_epoch002.pt; world 128 (32 nodes x 4 GPUs); 600 steps, checkpoints every 100. The paper model continues from step_000200.pt (chosen among steps 200/400/600 by finding-level metrics of greedy generations on the internal validation set). Same --calibration, --dense, MIL and --locations arguments as SFT.
